kind: E1-next v6, split-clean SAVO-LM-core or SAO step-matched sensitivity
savo_scope: LM blocks only; separate vision/audio/world mixers unchanged

partition_receipt.policy: fixed10% image holdout; disjoint audio speakers; existing world episode split enforced
limitations: speaker ID derived from speaker_id or original LibriSpeech filename
no upstream near-duplicate or external-corpus exclusion claim
new training population differs from historical all-splits SAO

text_collation: per-microbatch WikiText, matching completed SAVO controls
loss_normalization: summed text cross-entropy plus 0.5*summed world MSE, divided by the effective batch valid text-target count; world-only steps divide by the effective batch size because they carry no text labels
world_action_space: 6-way steering buckets from convert_minerl.py scheme D
world_windows: K consecutive transitions inside one episode; never cross an episode boundary
budget_rule: text arm counts WikiText targets; modality text is extra
parameter_init: Per-name SHA256-derived normal std=.02; shared query/key/embedding/FFN tensors matched
text_stream: advances only on text steps; identical across arms within a seed

validation_manifest.dataset: legacy WikiText-103 JSONL; upstream revision unverified
validation_manifest.preprocessing: legacy per-row BOS + first 1022 GPT2 tokens + EOS; right-pad masked by length; no packing

resumable: checkpoints carry model, optimizer, all RNG states, counters and recorded sampler order
